owner_words: いや届いてますし、大丈夫ですよ。配信に毎回アクションするのも大変です
meaning: The Owner states the deliveries arrive. Delivery is verified up to send + read-back of the published original (PRESTART_PUSH_VERIFIED); no per-delivery acknowledgement by the Owner is required. Reports keep saying 'sent and read back', never 'read by the Owner' for a specific race.
